source_workflow: 7,412 linked guides > 15 lots of 500 (last 412); Lotto01 remains OPEN
caveats: 500/500 means every SOURCE ROW classified, not every WORK identified.
A single source row may legitimately match work and work version nodes (BWV82); no arbitrary collapsing of candidates.
The 101 numerical collision cases are negative constraints not historical work identities.
17 authorship review cards are documentary nodes, not certified musical works.
The 12 Beethoven source rows represent 4 collections and 11 individual guided members.
Duplicate source URLs are not sufficient for work identity: see BWV1070 vs 1069 and BWV968 vs 527.
Original and corrected guide URLs are both preserved.
No global graph promotion and no browser/Android rendering acceptance.
Albinoni 20/20 source rows now map to 16 DISTINCT staging works (4 shared 2-row source headings); Albéniz 3/3 map to distinct staging works; IDs still provisional.
